motivation: The 15-pair training set contains only three basket_id=0 pairs and only one basket_id=0/left-arm pair, while both protected oval-basket regressions use basket_id=0 with the left arm.

selection_observables: exact expert planning and replay feasibility

selection_rule: Select the first five strict-pair-valid natural FastWAM failures in targeted expert-feasible candidate order; never inspect imagination rewards during selection.

variants: spatial residual adapter without imagination reward
spatial residual adapter with paired-rank imagination reward weight 0.25
comparison_protocol.development_gate: Run the four predeclared diagnostic states before any broad evaluation.
comparison_protocol.final_test_rule: Use fresh expert-feasible seeds that are never inspected or used during collection, training, or development gating.

stop_criteria.collection: Stop after five selected strict-valid natural failures; do not extend collection based on reward values.
reject_current_candidate_if: the imagination adapter fails any originally successful protected diagnostic state that either the frozen ordinary residual or no-imagination adapter passes
the imagination adapter does not exceed the no-imagination adapter trained on exactly the same replay
offline trust-region or exact-pair audits fail
stop_criteria.after_rejection: Do not collect more of the same stratum to tune the result; revise chunk-level temporal credit assignment or the training objective.

preregistered_fresh_final_test_pool.selection_rule: Take the first ten exact expert-feasible candidates in order without inspecting any policy outcome.
preregistered_fresh_final_test_pool.use_rule: Do not inspect or run this pool unless the frozen development gate passes.
